column3: Setup: Use the article_references testdrive to setup for this test at /testdrive/article_references and log in as the publisher account specified by the testdrive
Setup: At the end of the test session please use the 'teardown' link provided by the testdrive to remove test assets from the system

Go to the "Upload Article XML" tab in the "Publisher Area" and upload the test resource file "with_references.xml" using the "DOAJ Native XML" format

http://testdoaj.cottagelabs.com//publisher/uploadfile

Test Resource: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DOAJ/doaj/feature/3985_references_article_metadata/doajtest/xml_upload_test_package/DOAJ/with_references.xml
wait a short amount of time for the job to process, then reload the page (do not re-submit the form data).  If the job remains in "pending", reload the page until the status changes.

column4: Your file is shown in the "History of uploads" with status "successfully processed", and the Note "1 articles imported (1 new, 0 updated)"
